# verifying-before-handoff (reference summary)

## Purpose
Check scene readiness, collect render and export evidence, write preview and runtime-attempt reports, and verify before handoff.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/verifying-before-handoff/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/verifying-before-handoff/contract.json` (`v2.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `evidence-and-handoff` / `scene-readiness-evidence-preview-and-attempt-report`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- A scene must be checked before render or export.
- Render or export evidence must be collected.
- A preview report or runtime-attempt report is needed.
- Work is about to be handed off.

## When not to use
- the user explicitly asked for a draft, not a verified deliverable → delegate to `troubleshooting-blender-output` (`references/skills/troubleshooting-blender-output.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to troubleshooting-blender-output)
- as a replacement for evidence collection → delegate to `planning-product-scenes` (`references/skills/planning-product-scenes.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to planning-product-scenes)
- to fabricate confidence in missing artifacts → delegate to `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to planning-lighting-and-materials)
- the user only needs a scene plan with no runtime or artifact evidence → delegate to `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to setting-up-blender-runtime)
- runtime readiness or path selection has not been completed and the user wants setup or routing; use setting-up-blender-runtime or setting-up-blender-runtime → delegate to `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to setting-up-blender-runtime)
- the task is GLB web integration after evidence is already classified and gated; use handing-off-glb-to-web → delegate to `handing-off-glb-to-web` (`references/skills/handing-off-glb-to-web.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to handing-off-glb-to-web)
- raw debug logs or crash triage → delegate to `troubleshooting-blender-output` (`references/skills/troubleshooting-blender-output.md`; use troubleshooting-blender-output instead)
- Diagnosing systematic runtime or scene defects (troubleshooting-blender-output) → delegate to `troubleshooting-blender-output` (`references/skills/troubleshooting-blender-output.md`; troubleshooting-blender-output)
- Running pre-attempt environment checks (setting-up-blender-runtime) → delegate to `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`; setting-up-blender-runtime)
- Selecting which runtime path to use before an attempt (setting-up-blender-runtime) → delegate to `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`; setting-up-blender-runtime)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `candidate_delivery_package` (`object`): Complete set of planning, quality validation, runtime attempt, and artifact evidence records
- `proposed_truth_state_claims` (`object`): Proposed Runtime status and Artifact status labels to audit against the 7-point release gate

### Optional inputs
- `active_blocker_or_failed_gate_notes` (`array`): Any upstream Warn/Fail quality verdicts or unresolved runtime blockers
- `scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts` (`object`): Scene specification plus specialist rows from material, lighting, composition, and polycount checkers
- `acceptance_criteria_table` (`object`): Measurable Pass/Warn/Fail thresholds for the target deliverable
- `preview_or_inspection_notes` (`object`): Optional read-only scene inspection summary or viewport preview notes
- `candidate_artifact_records` (`array`): Reported file paths, byte sizes, SHA-256 digests, and inspection outputs for renders or GLBs
- `runtime_execution_trace` (`object`): Factual runtime attempt record indicating whether Blender actually ran
- `glb_inspector_or_validator_report` (`object`): Optional output from scripts/inspect-glb.mjs or Khronos gltf-validator
- `classified_artifact_evidence` (`object`): Verified or Produced artifact evidence record from verifying-before-handoff
- `quality_checker_summary` (`object`): Pass/Warn/Fail summary from verifying-before-handoff and specialist validators
- `known_visual_caveats` (`array`): Optional non-blocking visual warnings or pending stakeholder review questions
- `attempted_runtime_path_and_host` (`object`): Path 1, Path 2, or CLI appendix route and MCP host configuration used during the attempt
- `chronological_execution_log` (`array`): Timestamped sequence of read-only or mutation tool calls, responses, and observed outcomes
- `version_stamps` (`object`): Exact Blender version, add-on version, and MCP client version strings
- `pre_mutation_backup_record` (`object`): Optional .blend checkpoint backup metadata if an L1+ mutation was attempted

### Primary outputs
- `seven_point_release_gate_table`
- `enforced_downgrade_only_truth_states`
- `release_clearance_or_remediation_route`
- `holistic_scene_quality_verdict`
- `aggregated_pass_warn_fail_table`
- `blocking_defect_remediation_route`
- `artifact_truth_state_ledger`
- `downgrade_only_evidence_classification`
- `missing_evidence_remediation_checklist`
- `stakeholder_preview_evidence_packet`
- `truth_state_and_provenance_summary`
- `pre_handoff_gate_submission`
- `structured_runtime_attempt_report_md`
- `locked_runtime_and_artifact_truth_labels`
- `eval_evidence_archival_path`

## Quick-start procedure
1. Confirm the user's goal and the current runtime and artifact state.
2. Pick the branch in the decision tree below.
3. Load only that branch's reference file and follow it.
4. Reply with the user-facing template, keeping truth states honest.

## Handoff notes
- **[boundary_delegation]** Entry wiring (using-blendops) → `using-blendops` (`references/skills/using-blendops.md`) — `when.all: [request.scope equals "general_help"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Entry wiring (using-blendops) → `using-blendops` (`references/skills/using-blendops.md`) — `when.all: [preflight.passed equals true; inventory.exists equals true]`
- **[conditional]** If verdict is Pass (using-blendops) → `using-blendops` (`references/skills/using-blendops.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "final_communication"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** scene/asset quality gap (planning-camera-and-framing) → `planning-camera-and-framing` (`references/skills/planning-camera-and-framing.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "composition"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** scene/asset quality gap (planning-lighting-and-materials) → `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "lighting"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** scene/asset quality gap (planning-lighting-and-materials) → `planning-lighting-and-materials` (`references/skills/planning-lighting-and-materials.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "material"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** scene/asset quality gap (budgeting-glb-for-web) → `budgeting-glb-for-web` (`references/skills/budgeting-glb-for-web.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "polycount"; budget.verdict equals "Not Run"]`
- **[fallback]** runtime/bridge failure (troubleshooting-blender-output) → `troubleshooting-blender-output` (`references/skills/troubleshooting-blender-output.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.errorDetected equals true]`
- **[fallback]** runtime/bridge failure (setting-up-blender-runtime) → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path not_equals "unselected"; runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`
- **[fallback]** runtime/bridge failure (setting-up-blender-runtime) → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.conflictDetected equals true]`
- **[conditional]** Web delivery (when applicable) → `handing-off-glb-to-web` (`references/skills/handing-off-glb-to-web.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; handoff.consumerStack equals "web_glb"]`
- **[upstream_reference]** Runtime path selection context → `setting-up-blender-runtime` (`references/skills/setting-up-blender-runtime.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path equals "unselected"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (replaces older 3-stack and 4-route drafts — see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md` for the corrected attribution history):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not claim render, export, preview, or GLB results without evidence.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
